title: Inception
text: Dom Cobb is a thief who enters other people's dreams to steal information. A businessman named Saito hires him to do the reverse: plant an idea in the mind of Robert Fischer. Cobb and his team construct several layers of dreams to convince Fischer to break up his father's company.

title: Interstellar
text: Christopher Nolan directed Interstellar. As crop failures threaten life on Earth, former pilot Cooper joins a crew that travels through a wormhole in search of a planet where humanity could survive. His daughter Murph stays on Earth and works on a way to evacuate the people who remain there.

title: The Matrix
text: A computer hacker known as Neo learns from Morpheus that the world he experiences is a simulation called the Matrix. Intelligent machines use it to control humans. Neo joins a group of rebels and begins to discover how he can alter the simulated world from within.

title: Pulp Fiction
text: The cast of Pulp Fiction includes John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis. The film connects several stories in the Los Angeles criminal underworld, including two hitmen retrieving a briefcase for their boss and a boxer paid to lose a fight.

title: Dark
text: When a child disappears in the German town of Winden, four families look for answers. Their investigation uncovers links between disappearances decades apart and reveals how time travel has shaped their lives.

title: The Queen's Gambit
text: Beth Harmon discovers her talent for chess while living in a Kentucky orphanage. She enters competitive tournaments and rises through the chess world while struggling with addiction.
